in_arabic.name: Annissa
in_arabic.long_meaning: Annissa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'Ans', which means 'supporter' or 'helper'. The name Annissa signifies a beautiful and graceful woman, one who is a helper and supporter to those around her. This name is mentioned in the Quran, where Allah (SWT) says, 'And remember the favour of Allah upon the prophet, when he was attacked [in the battle of Uhud], and [when] he [his companions] said, 'Have no fear this day. Indeed, Allah is with us.' So Allah sent down His tranquillity upon him and supported him with angels. And those who followed [Belief after him] also said, 'Allah is indeed with us.' And Allah sent down to them a force of two hundred thousand angels, and made them the companions of those who believed. It is Allah who strengthens with His support whom He wills and [he is] Exalted in Might and Wise.
